name: Blazy Susan | 1 1/4 Papers | Grateful Dead
description: A match made in Deadhead heaven. Blazy Susan has joined forces with iconic rock group, The Grateful Dead, to bring you their very first and only line of papers! Proudly vegan and non-GMO, these Grateful Dead rolling papers are made in France using premium materials that deliver a high quality slow burn with no aftertaste.
